featured_reviews.review_text:
WARNING: FRAUD SHOP! Dishonest Pricing & Aggressive Management
Do not trust Unique Tiles in Nalasopara West. They are running a blatant "bait-and-switch" scam. I visited them twice, and both times they tried to cheat me after a price was already fixed.
The Scam: They lure you in with a reference and a fair price (₹400/box). Once you commit to a large order (70 boxes), they suddenly claim "stock out" or jack the price up to an insane ₹550/box.
The Deception: They use "missing staff" as an excuse to ignore previous commitments made by their own team.
Abusive Behavior: When I confronted the owner about the original price, he became extremely aggressive. He pointed fingers at me, shouted, and called me a liar.
The Cowardly Act: I challenged him to check his own CCTV cameras to prove the price he quoted. He initially agreed to the challenge but backed out immediately when he realized he was caught in his own lie. He then tried to "bargain" at ₹450 just to save face.
This isn't just bad service; it is a calculated fraud to trap customers and then bully them into paying more. AVOID AT ALL COSTS. They have no ethics, no professional manners, and zero honesty. Don't let them waste your time or insult your dignity like they did mine.

Also mentioned photos visited to them

featured_reviews.name: Ab Jeet
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited a local MR DIY shop, and I have mixed feelings about my experience. While the shop offers a wide variety of products at reasonable rates, there were a couple of aspects that left me slightly disappointed. Here's my three-star review:

Extensive Variety at Affordable Prices: One of the standout features of this MR DIY shop is the vast array of products available. From household items to stationery, tools, and even small electronics, they truly offer a one-stop shopping experience. Additionally, the prices are quite reasonable, making it a budget-friendly option for customers.

Majority of Products Made in China: One drawback that I noticed was that a significant portion of the products available in the shop were made in China. While this might not be an issue for some, it would be nice to see a more diverse range of products from different countries. However, it's worth noting that the shop's pricing reflects the lower production costs associated with these products.

Lack of Gift Wrapping Service: Another disappointment was the absence of a gift wrapping service. In today's busy world, having the convenience of getting your gifts wrapped at the same place you purchase them can be a significant time-saver. It's a missed opportunity for the shop to enhance the customer experience, especially considering that even smaller shops often provide this service

Overall, the MR DIY shop offers a wide variety of products at reasonable prices, making it a convenient option for shoppers. However, the reliance on products made in China and the absence of a gift wrapping service were aspects that slightly detracted from the overall experience. If you're looking for a budget-friendly shopping trip with a diverse selection of items, this shop is worth considering. However, if you prioritize locally made products or require gift wrapping services, you may need to explore alternative options.
